metadata.title: Organic Texture Collage with Geometric Header

retrievalProfile.description: A high-texture macro nature background featuring a contrasting solid-color header with custom geometric lettering.
triggerTerms: sage green top banner with white text

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, tactile composition dominated by macro photography of tree bark and dried vegetation, topped with a solid sage-green horizontal bar containing white, stylized geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the chaotic organic texture and the rigid geometric header
Subtle inset rectangular frames containing variations of the main texture
Muted earth-tone palette grounded by a single desaturated green accent
coreInvariants: Full-width horizontal header bar at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The organic texture occupies 85% of the frame from the bottom up; the header occupies the top 15%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid sage-green header bar acts as the primary visual anchor and entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast header and move downward through the complex, non-linear textures of the bark.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is intentionally crowded and tactile, with the header bar providing the only 'rest' area.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across all elements; high value contrast between the white text and the green background.

letterConstructionRules: Inverted triangular stems for letters like 'I' and 'T'
Uniform stroke weight within individual characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'I' is rendered as a downward-pointing triangle
The 'W' features a sharp, jagged internal structure
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single experimental display face against a complex photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric and unconventional letterforms
Matches the aggressive, pointed nature of the custom glyphs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a macro photograph of rough tree bark with small inset rectangular panels showing different dried plant textures like twigs and leaves. Add a solid sage-green bar across the top 15% of the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom geometric white lettering centered within the green bar, using sharp triangular shapes for vertical strokes.

verificationChecks: Is the header bar a solid sage green?
Are the letterforms sharp and geometric with triangular elements?
Is the background a high-detail macro bark texture?
Is the text color pure white?

mustRedesign: Avoid exact replication of the specific band name or logo
Ensure the bark texture is a generic natural pattern
postGenerationChecks: Confirm the header bar is perfectly horizontal and flush to the top
Verify the typography is centered within the green bar
Check that the bark texture feels organic and non-repetitive
Ensure the white text has sufficient contrast against the sage green
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro [Natural Texture] + Solid [Muted Color] Header + [Geometric Custom Lettering] in White
